sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Pentomino Puzzle is a straightforward game where you're presented with a set of geometric shapes, and your goal is to arrange them into a rectangle. The game's simplicity is its greatest strength, as it allows players of all ages and skill levels to jump in and start playing. To move a shape, simply move your mouse pointer over it and click the left button to pick it up, then drag it to the desired location. On touch screens, press and hold the shape with your finger and drag it around.

One of the most important aspects of Pentomino Puzzle is the attention to detail required to solve each puzzle. As you progress through the levels, the shapes become increasingly complex, and the number of pieces to arrange grows. To succeed, you'll need to carefully plan your moves, taking into account the shape and size of each piece, as well as the available space in the rectangle.

The game's physics engine is also noteworthy, as it allows for smooth and realistic movement of the shapes. This adds a layer of depth to the gameplay, making it feel more immersive and engaging.
